chat.title: Help
chat.intro: Ask how reporting works, or paste a ticket ID like NIV-2026-000123 to see where it stands. Ticket answers come straight from our records.
chat.ticketsFound: Here is what our records say:
chat.unknown: I can't find {ids}, or it isn't a ticket you can see. Check the ID on your counterfoil.
chat.triage: Waiting for the city to pick a department
chat.generalNote: General guidance, not an official answer.
chat.fallback: AI help isn't available right now. You can still paste a ticket ID, or ask for "my complaints".
chat.limited: That's a lot of questions in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
chat.failed: Your question didn't reach Nivaran. Check your connection and send it again.
chat.signInBody: Help answers questions about your own tickets, so it needs to know who you are.
